Theme

Common words: verbs, qualities & ideas

possible adjective

also as soon as possible, if possible, as … as possible, it’s possible, possibility, there’s a possibility that, potential, it may be that, it could be that, potentially, ASAP, that’s possible

classical

Cic. Fam. 13.73.2: potest fierī, ut fallar
Traupman 62, 174
Traupman 61: cum prīmum fierī potest, as soon as possible
Traupman 212: sī fierī potest, if possible

fierī potest (ut)

phrase: ut with the subjunctive

it is possible (that)

Sī fierī potest, or just sī potest, if possible (Traupman 84, 212; Cato); fierī nōn potest ut, it cannot be that.

Other words

  • quam (+ superlative) — as … as possible; quam prīmum, as soon as possible

    adverb, with a superlative · also used · classical · Cic. Fam. 14.4.1: quam prīmum; Cic. Fam. 14.14.2: quam saepissimē; Traupman 54, 86; Traupman 55: quam prīmum, as soon as possible; Traupman 193: quam prīmum · Wiktionary

  • possibilis, possibile — possible (a technical term)

    also used · classical · Quint. 3.8.25 (Lewis & Short); Traupman 363 · Declension on Wiktionary

    Quintilian’s rendering of Greek δυνατόν in rhetoric, later a legal term; everyday Latin says fierī potest.

Examples

  • ego vērō tē quam prīmum, mea vīta, cupiō vidēre

    I want to see you as soon as possible, my darlingCic. Fam. 14.4.1

  • vōs, meae cārissimae animae, quam saepissimē ad mē scrībite

    my dearest hearts, write to me as often as you canCic. Fam. 14.14.2

  • fundum eōdem diē, sī potest, circumeat

    let him walk round the farm the same day, if possibleCato, Agr. 2.1

  • fierī nōn potest ut fīlius istārum lacrimārum pereat

    it cannot be that the son of these tears should be lostAug. Conf. 3.12.21

  • quam prīmum

    as soon as possibleTraupman 68

  • Sī fierī potest…

    If (it is) possible…Traupman 363
